texts.preamble: State Of Gujarat vs Ganesh Monghaji Chaudhary-M/S ... on 22 April, 2018 Author: B.N. Karia Bench: B.N. Karia R/Cr.A/633/2012 Order
texts.facts: He has produced the authorization letter issued by the remaining respondents namely Prakashbhai Karshanbhai Chaudhary, Harilal Virsangbhai Chaudhary, Ishvarbhai Ramjibhai Chaudhary, Pathubhai Meghjibhai Chaudhary and Ganeshbhai Meghjibhai Chauhdary. In the authorization letter, the respondents No. 1, 4, 5, 6 and 7 have put their signatures along with their photographs and their signatures are identified by Mr. Hitesh Raval, learned advocate in the authorization letter. Learned advocate Mr. Hitesh Raval is present before the court and stated that these respondents are known to him and confirmed their signatures in the authorization letter.
texts.arguments: 3. It is submitted that the offence alleged against the accused under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, is not serious in nature, the penalty / punishment prescribed for such offence is not substantial in view of the Sections 51 and 52 of the Food Safety and R/CR.A/633/2012 ORDER Standard Act, 2006.
